Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), positive nitrites, and hematuria. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. No ketones or casts were detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy based on sensitivity testing.
